Mapmaker’s War

Build a base, dig ore, take the towns, and flatten the other sides before they flatten you.

Left
Select, or drag a box round units
Right
Move, take a town, mine ore, or mark an enemy and all near it
Alt
With right-click, attack the one enemy alone
Shift
With right-click, add an enemy or a place to those taken in turn
A / S
Attack-move, stop
D
Next formation for the selected units: line, block, column, wedge, square, loose
L
Next stance: seek and destroy, aggressive, defensive, or hold ground
J
Fall back when badly hurt, on or off
Shift+J
Selected scouts explore by themselves, or stop
Right-click your own
Guard that unit or building: follow it and fight what comes at it
Alt-click
On a unit's card, train it over and over until Alt-clicked again
Ctrl 1-9
Set a group, then 1-9 picks it
Arrows
Move the view; on a trackpad swipe to move and pinch to zoom
K
Another pen technique
Enter
In a game with other people, say something to everyone; the microphone in the bar puts you on voice

Skirmish

Map

Copper and iron lie by each base, silver farther out and gold in the middle. Gold pays most a load but digs slowly and soon runs out. Iron digs fastest and lasts longest. Copper runs in veins through the iron, and gold through the silver.
